progression.name: Timber Storehouse
progression.change: Warm timber shell, simple blue pitched roof, basic divided shelves/crates; all6zones allocated from first stage

progression.name: Reinforced Storehouse
progression.change: Same footprint/entry; substantial gray stone footing, steel corner straps, improved roof and modular shelves/cabinets

progression.name: Insulated Supply Depot
progression.change: Same footprint/entry; thicker blue/orange insulated envelope, steel reinforcements and taller denser internal shelving; no extra annex or footprint expansion

design_lock.form: Compact enclosed rectangular gable-roof house, not a pad/bench/factory; centered broad paired front sliding doors with clear threshold; crate emblem in front gable; continuous substantial rounded construction
design_lock.palette: Warm orange-brown timber, royal/navy blue roof and selected panels, restrained orange hardware/trim, cream rope where appropriate, soft white sculpted snow, gray stone footing, brown leather details
design_lock.footprint: One unchanged compact rectangular building footprint and small front delivery apron across all3visual stages; vertical/material improvements only, no approved world-unit dimensions asserted
design_lock.front: Centered paired sliding doors, crate emblem in gable, short nearly flush dark delivery pad with thin pale border; no stocked items blocking entrance
design_lock.right: One orange-framed vented service hatch for the partitioned fuel compartment; wall is on viewer-right in front view
design_lock.left: One small high horizontal frosted window; wall is on viewer-left in front view
design_lock.rear: Closed wall with small high circular gable vent; no duplicated front doors or crate emblem
design_lock.roof: Front-to-rear pitched ridge, softly rounded blue roof panels, thick snow edges; roof geometry and hardware remain coherent across each tier sheet
design_lock.interior: U-shaped perimeter storage around a clear central aisle; all6zones fixed per resource-coverage.json; distinct raw/prepared/grain food compartments and fuel partition; no loose meat/fish on floor or touching fuel/minerals
design_lock.view_convention: Four elevated cardinal views; labels FRONT0, RIGHT90, REAR180, LEFT270. In RIGHT90 front end is image-left; in LEFT270 front end is image-right. Only camera changes within a tier sheet; closed exterior doors/hatches are identical in all4views. Organization sheet changes explicit open/empty/stocked states of the approved advanced shell.
design_lock.presentation: Polished chunky rounded stylized3D, unclipped whole-building views, light-gray studio background, soft daylight shadows and small snow base; small unobtrusive titles/angle labels. No humans, animals, scenery, smoke, furnace, weapons, fake HUD values or numeric prices/capacities.
